verdict.rationale: three.js is an MIT-licensed JavaScript library, and that license was verified from the npm registry. It is distributed via npm (0.186.0, about 12M weekly downloads) and its full source can be cloned with `git clone`, so users can run and serve the core library entirely on their own infrastructure. missing for 10: an explicit first-party guide to serving the build and addons locally instead of via CDN import maps, and independent community corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
